en: Black‑and‑white image of a large rectangular town square with a dirt or unpaved surface, framed by late‑19th‑century multi‑storey brick buildings. In the center background stands a prominent three‑storey institutional building with a symmetrical facade, arched main entrance, balcony, and small clock or crest above the doorway. A tall decorative streetlamp or flagpole rises from the middle of the square. On the left and right edges are rows of attached townhouses or commercial buildings with shop signs in German on the ground floors.
